P.name: Unseen Threat
P.title: Template:Data Kha'Zix/Unseen Threat
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Unseen Threat|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Kha'Zix |skill = I |blurb = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Kha'Zix}} gains ''Unseen Threat'' whenever the enemy loses {{tip|sight}} of him causing his next basic attack against an enemy Champion to deal bonus magic damage and slow. |blurb4 = {{sbc|Unseen Threat:}} '''Kha'Zix's''' next basic attack against an enemy champion deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for a short time. |icon = Unseen Threat.png |description = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kha'Zix''' gains ''Unseen Threat'' whenever the enemy loses {{tip|sight}} of him or he activates ''{{ai|Void Assault|Kha'Zix}}''.

{{sbc|Unseen Threat:}} '''Kha'Zix''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} against an enemy champion to deal {{pplevel|17 to 136|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|slow}} them by 25% for 2 seconds. |targeting = Passive |affects = Enemies |damagetype = Magic |spellshield = False |spelleffects = spell |grounded = |knockdown = |parry = True |notes = * Any form of vision loss may trigger ''Unseen Threat'', such as {{ai|Curse of the Black Mist|Senna}}, {{tip|nearsight}} and {{ai|Brushmaker|Ivern}}. * {{ai|Void Assault|Kha'Zix}} grants ''Unseen Threat'' even if '''Kha'Zix''' never becomes unseen (e.g. affected by {{tip|true sight}}). ** Other {{tip|stealth}} such as {{cai|E|Senna}} does not do this. * Both the attack's damage and bonus spell damage are grouped under the same {{tip|cast instance}}. ** Because of this, a single ''Unseen Threat'' attack does '''not''' trigger two {{ri|Electrocute}} stacks. |yvideo = iWzC9fV6ieo }}

Q.name: Taste Their Fear
Q.title: Template:Data Kha'Zix/Taste Their Fear
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Taste Their Fear|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Kha'Zix
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Unseen Threat 2.png
|blurbicon=Taste Their Fear.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Kha'Zix}} considers any enemy unit to be {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} if they are not nearby to one of their allies. His abilities have special interactions against {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} targets.
|blurb2      =  {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kha'Zix''' slashes the target enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, increased against {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} targets.
|post-blurb= Kha'Zix/Evolved Reaper Claws
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kha'Zix''' considers any enemy unit to be {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} if they are not nearby to one of their allies. ''{{ai|Taste Their Fear|Kha'Zix}}'', ''{{ai|Evolved Reaper Claws|Kha'Zix}}'', and ''{{ai|Evolved Spike Racks|Kha'Zix}}'' have special interactions against {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} targets.
|icon2        = Taste Their Fear.png
|description2  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kha'Zix''' slashes the target enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, increased to 210% against {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} targets.
|leveling2     = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 180}} {{as|(+ 105% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Isolated Target Physical Damage|{{ap|80*2.1 to 180*2.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|105*2.1}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 325
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|375|Non-isolated radius between enemies / monsters}}
|cooldown     = 4
|cost         = 20
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Single target
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|callforhelp  = True
|notes        = 
* A team's allies are {{tip|champions}}, {{tip|pet|pets}}, {{tip|minions}} and outer {{tip|turret|turrets}}. 
** {{tip|Monsters}} are considered allies for other monsters.
** {{tip|Wards}} do not prevent ''Isolation''.
* A number of targetable [[champion summoned units]] are specifically tagged to not be a valid ally of a potentially ''Isolated'' target. These units are:
** {{cai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}
** {{cai|Prophet of an Elder God|Illaoi}}
** {{cai|Captive Audience|Jhin}}
** {{cai|Bushwhack|Nidalee}}
** {{cai|Tunnel|Rek'Sai}}
** {{cais|Absolution|Senna}} ''Mist Wraiths''
** {{cai|Noxious Trap|Teemo}}
** {{cais|Sovereign's Domination|Viego}} ''Mist Wraiths''
** {{cai|Dark Procession|Yorick}}
* {{as|Isolation|buzzword}} effects are registered at the following timings for each ability:
** For ''{{ai|Evolved Reaper Claws|Kha'Zix}}'', the start of cast.
** For ''{{ai|Evolved Spike Racks|Kha'Zix}}'', when the enemy is hit.
** For ''Taste Their Fear'', the end of cast.{{bug}} This means that if the target is no longer {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} when the ability hits them, ''Taste Their Fear'' will not apply the respective bonuses.
* ''Isolated'' targets are marked by an [[File:Unseen Threat 2.png|20px]] indicator, shown to '''Kha'Zix''', when visible and within {{tt|2500|Estimated}} units of him. This indicator is independent of the actual effects and its timing may not be fully accurate.{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
<!--To do
- Isolated indicator.
- Interactions with: enemy decoys, hiding in brush (and whether seeing an enemy with Oracle Lens affects it), and stealthed or Senna-wraithed enemies not visible to Kha'Zix's team -->
|yvideo       = DYGkdJV23uU
}}

R.name: Void Assault
R.title: Template:Data Kha'Zix/Void Assault
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Void Assault|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Kha'Zix |skill = R |icon = false |blurb = {{sbc|Passive:}} Each rank in ''Void Assault'' allows '''Kha'Zix''' to evolve one of his abilities, granting it additional effects. |blurb2 = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kha'Zix}} gains {{ai|Unseen Threat|Kha'Zix}} and becomes {{tip|invisible}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a brief time. Upon breaking invisibility, ''Void Assault'' can be cast a second time at no additional cost. |post-blurb= Kha'Zix/Evolved Adaptive Cloaking |description = {{sbc|Passive:}} Each rank in ''Void Assault'' allows '''Kha'Zix''' to evolve one of his {{tip|abilities}}, granting it additional effects. Evolving an ability causes him to enter a 2-second [[cast time]].

'''''Kha'Zix''' cannot evolve while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.'' |icon2 = Void Assault.png |description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kha'Zix''' becomes {{tip|invisible}} for {{ap|1.25}} seconds, during which he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. |icon3 = Void Assault 2.png |description3 = After 2 seconds of leaving {{tip|invisibility}}, and for the next 12 seconds, ''Void Assault'' can be recast at no additional cost. |description4 = {{sbc|Recast}}: '''Kha'Zix''' mimics the first cast's effects. |cooldown = {{ap|100 to 70}} |cdstart = on-cast |cast time = none |cost = 100 |costtype = Mana |targeting = Auto |affects = Self |notes = *Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive. * '''Kha'Zix''' receives the evolution even if he dies while in cast time. * Every time ''Void Assault'' is ranked, a secondary menu will pop up for '''Kha'Zix''' to select an ability to evolve, this can only be done once per ability. ** The only way for '''Kha'Zix''' to evolve all of his abilities is to gain the fourth evolution point by being victorious in [[The Hunt is On!]] (by scoring a {{tip|takedown}} on {{ci|Rengar}}). * Using a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|breaks stealth}} at the end of the attack windup.{{bug|2}} }}
